services.name: Cold Plunge
services.desc: At Lostfork, the Finnish sauna is more than heat. It is a ritual rooted in centuries of tradition. For those who already understand the power of sauna bathing, this is where you come to practice it properly. Unhurried, immersive, and in rhythm with nature. Paired with our cold plunge and hot tub, the experience becomes what it was always meant to be. A cycle of stress release, and renewal. Inside the sauna, temperatures rise. Outside, the air cools you instantly. Then comes the plunge-sharp, awakening, undeniable. blurb: Escape the ordinary at Lostfork Basecamp, just an hour from Denver all without the I-70 traffic. Tucked along Geneva Creek, our mountain retreat offers luxury cabins with private hot tubs, romantic a-frame chalets, RV sites with full hookups, all creekside and immersed in nature.
